result.topic_en: Euler sets abbreviated symbols for the numerator of dφ/du and for the reciprocal distance c/z. He multiplies the two to get the trigonometric series for dφ/du, coefficient by coefficient. He then begins substituting numerical values, giving each coefficient with its logarithm written beneath it.
